definitions.explanation: Having all necessary parts or elements; lacking nothing. Indicates a state without defects or deficiencies.
When used adverbially ({完全|かんぜん}に), expresses doing something thoroughly or to the fullest extent.

notes:
{完全|かんぜん} is a na-adjective meaning perfect or complete.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {完全|かんぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (completely, perfectly)
- Noun modifier: {完全|かんぜん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {完全|かんぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (understand completely)
- {完全|かんぜん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (perfect condition)
- {完全|かんぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (fully recover)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧: flawless, impeccable (stronger emphasis on perfection)
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧: all, everything (quantity-focused, not quality)
